items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, a couple of songs, I would like to have had Johnny Hodges play them.

ctx.x: It's the way you do it.
Well, a couple of songs, I would like to have had Johnny Hodges play them. Because I could hear him playing the song when I wrote it, you know.
Well, he was singing when he played.
